steps.code:
# Fetch all habit log notes (ids 282-308) and parse content.
import re

all_notes_data = []
habit_order = None

for note_id in range(282, 309):
    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=access_token)
    title = note['title']
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for YYYY-MM-DD"
    m = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', title)
    if not m:
        print(f"Warning: no date in title for note {note_id}: {title}")
        continue
    date_str = m.group(1)
    content = note['content']
    # Parse lines: "habit: yes/no"
    habits = {}
    for line in content.splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if ':' in line and not line.startswith('#'):
            parts = line.split(':', 1)
            habit = parts[0].strip()
            value = parts[1].strip().lower()
            if value in ('yes', 'no'):
                habits[habit] = value
    if habit_order is None:
        # Get order from first note (282)
        habit_order = list(habits.keys())
    all_notes_data.append({'date': date_str, 'habits': habits})

print(f"Fetched {len(all_notes_data)} notes")
print("Habit order:", habit_order)
print("First few dates:", [d['date'] for d in all_notes_data[:3]])
